issues.description: Technology count mismatch: JSON claims 25 total technologies but actually contains 28
Tactical field category count mismatch: Claims 5 but JSON and tables show 6 (Repulsor Beam, Lightning Shield, Cloaking Device, Zyro Shield, Stasis Field, Black Hole Generator)
issues.location: force-fields.md, JSON 'categories.tactical_field' and '### Tactical Fields (5 total)' header
issues.suggestion: Update tactical_field count from 5 to 6 in JSON categories and in the section header '### Tactical Fields (6 total)'

issues.description: Shield cost formula does not match actual data values. Stated formula: 'Cost = 12 + (Shield_Class - 1) × 8 + (Shield_Class² × 0.5)' produces costs like 22, 32, 44... but actual table values are 18, 25, 32...
issues.suggestion: Either update the formula to match actual data, or update the data tables to match the formula. The actual values follow a reasonable progression but don't match the stated formula.

summary: The Force Fields technology tree specification is comprehensive and well-structured. It includes all required sections: Overview, complete tech tree with 14 tiers, detailed component statistics, formulas, JSON data schema, edge cases, and strategic analysis. The document is MOO1-faithful with appropriate tech categories (Deflector Shields, Planetary Shields, Personal Shields, Tactical Fields). The JSON is valid and parseable. References to other spec files are correct and those files exist. Naming follows LORE.md conventions (Hermit Crabs racial bonus matches crystalline shell lore). Three minor issues found: (1) total tech count discrepancy (25 stated vs 28 actual), (2) tactical field count discrepancy (5 stated vs 6 actual), (3) shield cost formula doesn't match actual table values. These are documentation consistency issues, not fundamental design flaws. Recommended to pass with minor corrections needed.
